comment: The virtual machine, as both the page (site/js/boot.js) and the snapshot tool (tools/make-snapshot.py) start it. A migration stream only resumes on a machine that matches the one it was taken from, device for device, so this is the one place the machine is described. {pack} is the -L directory holding the kernel, initramfs and BIOS blobs, {share} the directory exported over 9p, {ram} the guest RAM. Change anything here and the snapshot has to be retaken (docs/engine.md); the pins carry this file's hash so checks.snapshot notices.
